scope: Master and legacy ticker text rendering
issue: Long repeated ticker text was measured and rasterized repeatedly on each display frame
fix: Cache one measured glyph strip per output context, then translate it with fractional positions. Invalidate on text, font, color, size, shadow or font-load changes. Bound raster memory and preserve a direct drawing fallback.

regressions: Exact measured repeat geometry and width floor
Color, font, shadow, dimension and font-load invalidation
Bounded raster memory and oversized-track fallback
Zero-width font measurement avoids an unbounded loop

pixelMotion.method: Horizontal pixel-column matching with subpixel parabolic interpolation, processed after capture

native60fpsVerification.interpretation: Every consecutive captured frame visibly advances the ticker left; no stationary or backward frame pairs were measured. Pixel displacement is a subpixel estimate rather than an exact speed calibration.
